title: Relief Extension Months on Plans Carrying Several Invoices
content:
**Patient Payment Plans — schedule of relief extension months for plans carrying several invoices**

A plan carrying 2 or more enrolled invoices whose installments are drawn automatically adds 1 relief extension month; a plan carrying 2 or more enrolled invoices whose installments are not drawn automatically adds 2 relief extension months; any other plan adds none.

Relief extension months are added to the installments still to fall due over which a relief installment spreads the plan's carried balance; months from every source are added together, and the installments with all the relief extension months never carry the plan past its 24th installment.

| Enrolled invoices on the plan | Installments drawn automatically | Relief extension months |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | Yes | 1 |
| 2 or more | No | 2 |
| 1 | Yes or No | 0 |

**Enrolled invoices** are counted from the plan ledger, one for each invoice enrollment line on the plan. **Drawn automatically** reads the plan's automatic-payment setting; the method on file (bank transfer, credit card or debit card) does not change the result.

## Hypothetical plans

| Plan | Enrollment lines | Automatic payments | Months |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 3 | Yes, debit card | 1 |
| B | 2 | No, paid by check | 2 |
| C | 1 | No | 0 |
| D | 4 | Yes, bank transfer | 1 |
